dispositions.admission-no-app-code: The entry performs admission/gating only and executes no app JavaScript; the later execution entry owns the task boundary.
dispositions.construction-no-app-code: Construction/bootstrap code runs before app execution and invokes only captured bootstrap or pristine intrinsic functions.
dispositions.internal-checkpoint: The helper runs only while an existing outer host task is finalizing its nextTick/microtask or runtime-extension checkpoint closure.
dispositions.joins-outer-host-task: The helper or retained callback is reached only from an already classified outer host task and joins that task identity.
dispositions.outer-host-task: The runtime-owner ingress creates and explicitly finishes an outer ScopedRuntimeExtensionHostTask before publishing its result.
dispositions.restricted-no-app-code: The restricted UI-worklet runtime is structurally denied the app runtime's extension projections.
dispositions.test-only: The call exists only behind an Ibex test-hook build and is absent from production artifacts.
dispositions.trusted-bootstrap-no-app-code: The named owner transition evaluates fixed native-owned seal bytes before any user-execution ingress; no app-controlled source or callback can run, and any failure quarantines the generation.
